title: Aspen Search mono button
description: A square-cornered 36px button with a mono capital label on the left and a thin arrow on the right: ink-filled or outlined on paper. On hover a mint (or ink) fill sweeps in from the left over 0.8s and the label changes colour with it.
notes: CSS only; the sweep is off under reduced motion
name: aspensearch-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label; shown in mono capitals

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: tone
props.description: ink: filled with the primary colour, a mint fill sweeps in on hover · paper: outlined, an ink fill sweeps in

props.name: width
props.description: "fixed": the original's 200px width · "full": the container's width
